title: Google Ads for Hair Salons - Ultimate 2025 Guide to Boost Bookings and Revenue

facts.fact: The page says a small hair salon should spend ₹10,000–₹20,000 per month on Google Ads.
The page gives a mid-size hair salon Google Ads spend range of ₹20,000–₹50,000, without stating a time period.
The page gives a high-end hair salon Google Ads spend of ₹50,000 or more.
The page recommends setting a local targeting radius of about 5 to 10 km around the salon.
The page suggests YouTube video ads for salons run about 15–30 seconds.
facts.quote: Short 15–30 sec videos showing hair transformations

facts.fact: The page gives 'Refer a Friend and Save ₹500' as an example salon promotional offer.
The page gives 'First Haircut 20% Off' as an example salon promotional offer.
The page states that Local Service Ads (Google Guaranteed) appear above search ads and carry a Google-backed badge.
facts.quote: help salons build trust immediately with a Google-backed badge.
